title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Element…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BdThemes Element Pack Elementor Addons up to version 10.0.9. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts that execute in users' browsers.
